The projects resolver being broken is an actual replica limitation (per the replica notes, "all projects queries return an error"), but the solver didn't need it: the document's team field was readable, and neither document had team = Growth. The outcome wasn't decided by the replica's behavior; it was decided by the timeout. So artifact doesn't apply.
